verdict.rationale: PagerDuty Advance and its components (Scribe Agent for post-incident reviews, SRE Agent, Intelligent Alert Grouping via ML, AIOps insights claiming 91% alert reduction) provide AI-generated insights and suggestions embedded in the product, going beyond mere automation. However, evidence is largely first-party marketing copy with no independent/hands-on validation of insight quality, and community feedback is silent on these newer AI features (mostly discussing core paging/escalation). Missing for 10: independent verification of AI-generated insight quality, concrete examples of suggestions surfaced in-product, and community corroboration of the AI/Advance features specifically.
